messages:
sam: Quick thread to align on "guaranteed microburst" scope for Dedicated. Customer asks: short guaranteed bursts, clear preempt order, and non-surprise billing.

maya: Rephrase: baseline reservation + a short protected window (e.g., 20-45s) where we avoid preemption if possible, then spill gracefully.

rhys: Ops note: protected window still needs an upper bound. Customers expect bounded behavior. Suggest soft_window = 30s default, configurable per-tenant.

tanya: Billing: prefer simple GA behavior. Option 1: spilled tokens billed at reserved rate. Option 2: spilled billed at hosted rate. Product leaning to Option 1 to reduce friction.

maya: Proto sketch (for runtime & ops simulation):

```
microburst_policy {
  baseline_qps: 80
  burst_multiplier: 2.0
  soft_window_secs: 30
  preempt_protection: false
  spill_mode: SPILL_TO_HOSTED
  billing_mode: RESERVED_RATE
}
```

ops-bot: analytics job `microburst_profile_v1` created for tenants tagged `microburst-pilot`. Daily summary -> #eng-runtime.

rhys: Launch checklist suggestion: feature flag, unit + integration tests for preempt ordering, canary with 2 pilot customers in APAC for 10 days, dashboards for spill/eviction/cost, runbook with manual soft-window override.

sam: Action owners: maya = proto & product doc, rhys = canary plan & dashboards, tanya = billing toggle + guardrails. I'll schedule a 20m sign-off Fri. If no objections by EOD I will lock scope. :thumbsup:
